title: Probing + Weighted Canary / A-B Autorollback Workflow
author: Riya Kapoor
body:
Summary: Implements a probing + weighted canary/A-B autorollback workflow that allows progressive traffic probing followed by conditional weighted canary or A/B promotion with automatic rollback on composite metric regressions. Motivation: We want a single, auditable rollout blueprint that supports (1) short-lived probing traffic to detect gross regressions, (2) conditional promotion to weighted canary or A/B lanes, and (3) automated rollback when quorum-based metrics indicate degradation. This PR consolidates previous ad-hoc probing steps, adds safety guards for noisy metrics, and wires in observability for post-rollback forensics.

What changed (high level):
- New workflow definition: rollouts/workflows/probing_weighted_canary.yaml — canonical state machine for probing -> staged weighted canary / A-B -> promote or rollback.
- Autorollback engine enhancements: rollouts/autorollback/engine.py — adds composite metric quorum evaluation, time-windowed baselines, and quarantine stage support.
- Routing & weight controller: rollouts/controllers/weight_controller.py — supports fractional traffic ramps with manual override hooks.
- Observability: observability/metrics/rollback_metrics.md and metrics instrumentation added across autorollback to emit rollback_reason, metric_quorum, and probe_success_rate.
- E2E and unit tests: tests/e2e/probing_canary_test.py, tests/unit/test_autorollback_metrics.py.
- Docs: docs/unified-rollouts/probing-weighted-canary.md describing config knobs, recommended thresholds, and troubleshooting steps.

Checklist: 
- [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-2319)
- [x] Unit tests added
- [x] E2E probing + rollback scenario added
- [x] Observability dashboards and alerts (basic)
- [x] Feature gated behind rollout.experiments.probing_weighted_canary

Behavior details:
- Probing stage: low percentage (0.1-1%) of traffic is probed for a short duration (configurable, default 5 minutes). If the probe passes quorum checks (latency/err_rate/quality metrics), the system advances to staged weighted canary.
- Weighted canary/A-B stage: traffic is ramped using configurable steps. Composite metrics are evaluated at each step using a quorum (N of M metrics must exceed threshold) to decide to continue or trigger rollback.
- Autorollback: When metric quorum fails, the engine immediately quarantines the new model variant, rewinds traffic to the previous stable variant, emits rollback_reason and rollback_metrics, and opens a ticket link if configured.
- Safety guards: minimum sample sizes, hysteresis windows, and manual hold points for teams that prefer supervision.

Testing and validation:
- Local unit tests cover quorum evaluation edge cases (noisy metrics, missing metrics).
- E2E test simulates a model with injected latency regressions and verifies that probing detects failure and triggers rollback before any heavy ramp.
- Load tests on staging show no measurable impact to main model latency due to async metric aggregation and lightweight probing agents.

Migration notes:
- Existing rollouts will not be migrated automatically. Admins can opt into the new workflow via the rollout templates UI or API.
- Feature is behind a feature flag (rollout.experiments.probing_weighted_canary) to allow staged rollout.

Related work: ENG-2319 (design), ENG-2398 (observability for autorollback), PRs #91234 and #920001 (previous autorollback iterations).

Risk and mitigations:
- False positives due to noisy metrics: mitigated by quorum logic and min sample size.
- Operator confusion: added docs and dashboard panels that show state transitions and key metrics.

Merge notes: squash-merge. Post-merge followups include expanding dashboards (ENG-2398) and adding SLI-driven canary auto-promote in a follow-up PR.

review_comments:
Ethan Liu: Please add min_sample_size guard — otherwise a single spike can trigger rollback.
Author: Added min_sample_size and unit tests covering it.

Samira Khan: We should expose an opt-out manual_hold step for enterprise customers.
Author: Added manual_hold hook and documented in the rollout guide.

Marco DiStefano: Observability events look good but can we emit a compact rollback_reason tag for downstream ingestion?
Author: Added rollback_reason and metric_quorum tags to instrumentation.
Ethan Liu: CI flake on e2e earlier, reran tests — all green now.

Composite metric quorum adds robustness to rollback decisions
